# Private Chocolate

> Private label chocolate and distribution partner for professional businesses.

Private Chocolate offers two services for distributors, food businesses, and professional buyers:

## Private Label
A ready chocolate product with your brand on it. You provide your branding (logo, name, label design) — we apply it to our professional matte black 1 kg resealable pouches via thermal label. Available in black & white or full-color label options. No product development needed — choose from our ready range and have your brand applied.

## Our Brand (Distribution)
A ready-made chocolate range under the Private Chocolate brand, designed for distributors who want to add quality chocolate products to their portfolio without creating their own brand. Products are supplied ready-to-sell to professional customers.

## Products
- 16+ flavours available: Classic Dark, Hazelnut, Strawberry, Milk Chocolate, Barista Blend, Bueno Style, and more
- Custom recipe options available
- Packaging: 0.5 kg, 1 kg, 2 kg professional matte black resealable pouches (varies by product)
- Ready recipes designed for professional use

## Who We Work With
- Distributors
- Cafés & Bakeries
- Foodservice
- Retailers
- HoReCa
